Some help wounded comrades.

High-end live-action cinematic realistic dark fantasy.

16:9 cinematic widescreen.

Feature-film quality.

Realistic human anatomy.

Natural subtle human movement.

Realistic facial expressions.

Natural eye contact and body language.

Realistic seated body posture.

Natural breathing and small body adjustments.

Realistic cloth, hair, armor, smoke, and fire physics.

All character dialogue in this video must be spoken in natural ENGLISH ONLY.

Use clear natural English pronunciation.

Speak the written dialogue exactly as written.

Do not translate the dialogue.

No additional spoken dialogue.

No background conversations.

Natural accurate lip synchronization.

No subtitles.

No captions.

No text.

No watermark.

No logo.


=== GLOBAL ACTION ===

The battle is already over.

Riven and Ally Soldier are resting together on the battlefield after surviving the fight.

This is their first relaxed conversation after Riven saved him in Scene 8.

The scene begins quietly.

They are exhausted and recovering.

Their interaction gradually becomes playful and friendly.

This is not a dramatic gratitude scene.

This is not romance.

This is simply the beginning of a natural friendship between two soldiers who have just survived a battle together.

Both characters should remain physically alive and natural throughout the scene.

They breathe, look around, shift their posture, interact with their equipment, and react naturally to each other.

Do not make either character sit completely frozen while speaking.


=== SCENE ===

Begin with Riven and Ally Soldier already resting beside a damaged low stone wall or large piece of battlefield debris.

They sit next to each other with a natural comfortable distance between them.

Riven sits in a relaxed tired posture.

One leg is slightly extended while the other rests naturally bent.

Her large sword rests safely beside her within easy reach.

She quietly wipes some dirt from her hand and forearm armor.

She looks across the battlefield.

Ally Soldier sits beside her with his back partially resting against the damaged stone behind him.

One knee is raised naturally in front of him while his other leg rests more loosely.

One forearm rests casually across his raised knee.

He is catching his breath after the battle.

His breathing is visible but calm.

Ally Soldier looks down at his equipment.

He adjusts the strap around one of his gloves or forearm armor.

He briefly checks a small scratch on his arm.

Then he brushes some dirt from his clothing.

Riven remains beside him, quietly recovering.

Allow a brief comfortable silence.

Around them, allied soldiers continue moving naturally through the battlefield.

Smoke drifts behind them.

Small fires remain visible in the distance.

Ally Soldier eventually looks toward Riven.

A faint amused expression appears on his face.

Ally Soldier:

"You always do that?"

Riven stops cleaning her armor and turns her head toward him.

She looks mildly confused.

Riven:

"Do what?"

Ally Soldier shifts slightly against the stone behind him.

He casually gestures toward the battlefield with one hand.

Ally Soldier:

"Run straight into trouble for someone else."

His hand drops naturally back onto his raised knee.

Riven looks at him.

Her eyes briefly move over his battered armor, as if the answer should be obvious.

Riven:

"You were about to die."

Ally Soldier looks down at himself.

He adjusts his seated position slightly.

He brushes some dirt from his glove and gives a small shrug.

Then he looks back toward Riven with mild wounded pride.

Ally Soldier:

"I had it handled."

Riven simply stares at him for a moment.

She clearly does not believe him.

Hold this small reaction naturally.

A very slight amused smile appears on Riven's face.

Riven:

"Sure you did."

Ally Soldier holds her gaze for a moment.

Then he gives a short natural laugh.

His shoulders move slightly with the laugh.

Riven gives a small genuine smile.

She looks away toward the battlefield again.

Ally Soldier's laughter fades naturally.

He also looks forward.

Allow another short comfortable silence.

Ally Soldier slowly stretches his leg a little and settles into a more comfortable position.

He rests his forearm again across his raised knee.

He looks down and idly rubs some dirt from his glove with his thumb.

Around them, allied soldiers continue recovering and helping each other.

The atmosphere is quiet compared with the battle before.

After a moment, Ally Soldier becomes slightly more sincere.

He continues looking toward the battlefield at first.

Then he briefly glances toward Riven.

Ally Soldier:

"Still... thanks."

Riven hears him.

She turns her eyes toward him.

Her expression remains calm and understated.

Riven:

"Anytime."

Ally Soldier gives her a small appreciative nod.

No more dialogue.

Riven looks back toward the battlefield.

She relaxes her shoulders and rests one hand naturally near her sword.

Ally Soldier also turns his attention forward.

He shifts his raised knee slightly and settles comfortably against the damaged stone.

Both remain naturally alive in the frame.

They continue breathing.

Their eyes occasionally follow movement across the battlefield.

Their clothing and hair move subtly in the wind.

Neither character becomes completely motionless.

The camera gradually moves into a wider composition.

Riven and Ally Soldier remain sitting together in the foreground.

Behind them, the recovering army continues moving through the battlefield.

Some soldiers walk between damaged structures.

Some help wounded comrades.

Others sit and recover.

Smoke slowly drifts across the environment.

Small fires continue burning among the remains of the battle.

Riven and Ally Soldier simply sit together looking across the battlefield.

Do not make them pose dramatically.

Do not make them look toward the camera.

CUT.


=== END STATE FOR CONTINUITY ===

The battle has ended.

Riven and Ally Soldier both survived.

Riven's sword remains intact.

Ally Soldier is the SAME soldier Riven saved in Scene 8.

They have now shared their first relaxed conversation together.

Ally Soldier is beginning to feel comfortable joking with Riven.

Riven is also beginning to accept his company naturally.

Their friendship has started, but they are not yet portrayed as deeply bonded.

This interaction naturally sets up the development of their friendship in Chapter 4.


=== MOOD ===

Quiet.

Tired.

Natural.

Warm without becoming sentimental.

The violence of the battle has passed, leaving a small peaceful moment between two soldiers.

Their humor should feel understated and believable.

Their friendship is only beginning.

Do not make the scene romantic.

Do not make Ally Soldier excessively grateful.

Do not make Riven emotionally dramatic.

The scene should feel like two exhausted soldiers slowly becoming friends after surviving the same battle.
